This is the first time I build a shower with a kit. We previously had a shower seat that was built from 2x4's and sheet rock. I figured this would be much easier to build in to our new shower. Since I also built an enclosed shower kit (also from Vevor) this seat will already be on a waterproof area so extra security there. It was easy enough to put in and am now in the process of tiling.
